thread.title_full: Ravenswood volleyball falls to Buffalo, defeats Fairmont Sr. and Petersburg

author: Mark Martin FOR JACKSON NEWSPAPERS
title: Ravenswood volleyball falls to Buffalo, defeats Fairmont Sr. and Petersburg
text:
RAVENSWOOD, W.Va. (WV News) - The Devilettes lost to Buffalo in a quad by identical scores of 25-17.
Anna Casto had 14 points, 20/22 spiking with eight kills, 6/6 serving with one ace and one block.
RAVENSWOOD, W.Va. (WV News) - The Devilettes lost to Buffalo in a quad by identical scores of 25-17.
Anna Casto had 14 points, 20/22 spiking with eight kills, 6/6 serving with one ace and one block.
Annie Starcher had 47 sets on target "with most of those sets on the move and under lots of stress due to bad passing," according to Michael. She also had two blocks.
Ravenswood knocked off Fairmont Sr., 25-11 and 25-21.
Casto had 14 points, was 9/10 serving with six aces, 12/14 spiking with seven kills and 11 passes
Annie Starcher had four points, 33 sets on target with 100 percent efficiency, 11/11 serving with two aces.
Holliday Burrows had 4 points, 3/5 spiking and two kills.
Maddie Slater was 8/8 serving with four aces
Ravenswood defeated Petersburg by winning two of three sets. Ravenswood took the first, 25-9 and the last 15-12. Petersburg was a 25-19 winner in the second set.
Anna Casto had 14 points, 11/11 serving with two aces, 18 passes, 15/16 spiking with 12 kills and one block.
Starcher had nine points, 13/14 serving with 4 aces, six passes and 50 sets on target.
Burrows had five points and was 10/10 spiking with five kills.
Petyon Mellinger five blocks.
Kinley Butcher six points, 13/19 spiking with five kills.
